Camber Capital Management Decreased Holding in Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) as Stock Declined; First Interstate Bank Has Raised Stake in Facebook (FB) by $1.86 Million as Shares Declined
May 30, 2018 - By Darrin Black
First Interstate Bank increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 35.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Interstate Bank bought 11,696 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,243 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.07M, up from 32,547 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Interstate Bank who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $543.76 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.14% or $2.11 during the last trading session, reaching $187.85. About 7.89M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
